## Sessions that cannot meet

Four of the fifteen Thursdays are blocked — one public holiday and three conferences. All four are made up. The form of the make-up is not the same for all of them, because what those sessions do is not the same.

| Week | Date | Why | What that session carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 9/24 | 추석 연휴 (9/24–26) | Framing week; the 15-minute IRB/ethics briefing; roles run |
| 8 | 10/22 | 건축학회 학술발표대회 | Pre-proposal presentations and live peer review |
| 10 | 11/5 | 건설관리학회 학술발표대회 | Causal inference; roles run; response-to-reviewers letters due |
| 13 | 11/26 | AKC 2026 | Data-driven research; roles run |

**Shifting the whole calendar is no longer on the table.** It was a live option when Chuseok was the only conflict. With four blocked Thursdays spread from September to November, shifting would push Week 15 past 12/10 and into the exam period.

**Weeks 4, 10 and 13 — asynchronous, with the role rotation preserved.** Recorded framing lecture; Method Lead, Exemplar Analyst and Skeptic segments submitted as written deliverables instead of presented live; entry tickets posted on the usual schedule; 15 minutes of live Q&A folded into the start of the following session. If you hold a role in one of these weeks, **it still counts as your turn** — you write it instead of presenting it.

**Week 8 needs a live meeting.** It is sixteen people presenting to each other and reviewing each other in the room; converting it to uploads removes the thing being assessed. Two workable options:

- **(a) A rescheduled session in the week of 10/22**, on a day the room and the class are both free.
- **(b) Fold the presentations into Week 9 (10/29)** and run that session long, with the regression/SEM material compressed and its overflow moved into the Week 10 make-up package.

Option (a) is better if a slot exists. Option (b) costs Week 9 its own depth and leans on a Week 10 that is already a make-up.

**One knock-on to watch.** Response-to-reviewers letters are currently due in Week 10 (11/5), and they respond to peer review from Week 8 (10/22). Both of those sessions have moved. Whatever is decided for Week 8, the letters follow it — the deadline is announced on ETL once the Week 8 date is fixed, not silently changed here.

**Still to be fixed:** the Week 8 make-up date, and therefore the response-to-reviewers deadline. Everything else on this page is settled.

No other Thursday in this span coincides with a 2026 Korean public holiday (Gaecheonjeol falls on Saturday 10/3, its substitute holiday on Monday 10/5; Hangeul Day falls on Friday 10/9 — neither touches a Thursday).
